title: 黑格子的数目
summary: m×n 网格中给出黑格坐标，统计恰有零到四个黑格的所有 2×2 子块数量。
insight: 一个黑格只可能影响以其左上、左下、右上、右下方向为边界的至多四个 2×2 块。枚举这些合法块并在哈希表累计黑格数；未出现在表中的块全是零黑格。
pitfalls: 每个黑格至多贡献四个块
总块数和答案使用 long

solutions.title: 按左上角统计受影响块
solutions.idea: 只建立至少含一个黑格的稀疏块计数。
steps: 若左上角落在合法范围，块计数加一

code.java: class Solution { public long[] countBlackBlocks(int m,int n,int[][] coordinates){Map<Long,Integer> count=new HashMap<>();for(int[] cell:coordinates)for(int dr=-1;dr<=0;dr++)for(int dc=-1;dc<=0;dc++){int row=cell[0]+dr,col=cell[1]+dc;if(row>=0&&row<m-1&&col>=0&&col<n-1){long key=(long)row*n+col;count.put(key,count.getOrDefault(key,0)+1);}}long[] answer=new long[5];answer[0]=(long)(m-1)*(n-1)-count.size();for(int value:count.values())answer[value]++;return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countBlackBlocks(m:Int,n:Int,coordinates:Array<IntArray>):LongArray{val count=HashMap<Long,Int>();for(cell in coordinates)for(dr in -1..0)for(dc in -1..0){val row=cell[0]+dr;val col=cell[1]+dc;if(row>=0&&row<m-1&&col>=0&&col<n-1){val key=row.toLong()*n+col;count[key]=(count[key]?:0)+1}};val answer=LongArray(5);answer[0]=(m-1).toLong()*(n-1)-count.size;for(value in count.values)answer[value]++;return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<long long> countBlackBlocks(int m,int n,vector<vector<int>>& coordinates){unordered_map<long long,int> count;for(auto& cell:coordinates)for(int dr=-1;dr<=0;++dr)for(int dc=-1;dc<=0;++dc){int row=cell[0]+dr,col=cell[1]+dc;if(row>=0&&row<m-1&&col>=0&&col<n-1)++count[(long long)row*n+col];}vector<long long> answer(5);answer[0]=(long long)(m-1)*(n-1)-count.size();for(auto [key,value]:count)++answer[value];return answer;} };
